title: Machine learning identifies ferroptosis-related genes as potential diagnostic biomarkers for osteoarthritis.
authors: Qiu, Yue; Yao, Jun; Li, Lin; Xiao, Meimei; Meng, Jinzhi; Huang, Xing; Cai, Yang; Wen, Zhenpei; Huang, Junpu; Zhu, Miaomiao; Chen, Siyuan; Long, Xingqing; Li, Jingqi
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习筛选骨关节炎铁死亡相关诊断标志物，属纯基因表达与临床诊断研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteoarthritis (OA) is one of the most common forms of degenerative arthritis and a major cause of pain and disability. Ferroptosis, a novel mode of cell death, has been verified to participate in the development of OA, but its mechanism is still unclear. This paper analyzed the ferroptosis-related genes (FRGs) in OA and explored their potential clinical value. METHODS: We downloaded data through the GEO database and screened for DEGs. Subsequently, FRGs were obtained using two machine learning methods, LASSO regression and SVM-RFE. The accuracy of the FRGs as disease diagnosis was identified using ROC curves and externally validated. The CIBERSORT analyzed the immune microenvironment rug regulatory network constructed through the DGIdb. The competitive endogenous RNA (ceRNA) visualization network was constructed to search for possible therapeutic targets. The expression levels of FRGs were verified by qRT-PCR and immunohistochemistry. RESULTS: In this study, we found 4 FRGs. The ROC curve showed that the combined 4 FRGs had the highest diagnostic value. Functional enrichment analysis showed that the 4 FRGs in OA could influence the development of OA through biological oxidative stress, immune response, and other processes. qRT-PCR and immunohistochemistry verified the expression of these key genes, further confirming our findings. Monocytes and macrophages are heavily infiltrated in OA tissues, and the persistent state of immune activation may promote the progression of OA. ETHINYL ESTRADIOL was a possible targeted therapeutic agent for OA. Meanwhile, ceRNA network analysis identified some lncRNAs that could regulate the FRGs. CONCLUSION: We identify 4 FRGs (AQP8, BRD7, IFNA4, and ARHGEF26-AS1) closely associated with bio-oxidative stress and immune response, which may become early diagnostic and therapeutic targets for OA.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨关节炎（OA）是最常见的退行性关节炎形式之一，也是疼痛和残疾的主要原因。铁死亡（ferroptosis）作为一种新型细胞死亡模式，已被证实参与OA的发展，但其机制仍不清楚。本文分析了OA中的铁死亡相关基因（FRGs），并探讨了其潜在的临床价值。方法：我们通过GEO数据库下载数据并筛选差异表达基因（DEGs）。随后，使用两种机器学习方法，即LASSO回归和SVM-RFE，获得FRGs。通过ROC曲线评估FRGs作为疾病诊断的准确性，并进行外部验证。CIBERSORT分析了通过DGIdb构建的免疫微环境调控网络。构建竞争性内源RNA（ceRNA）可视化网络以寻找可能的治疗靶点。通过qRT-PCR和免疫组化验证FRGs的表达水平。结果：在本研究中，我们发现了4个FRGs。ROC曲线显示，4个FRGs联合具有最高的诊断价值。功能富集分析表明，OA中的4个FRGs可能通过生物氧化应激、免疫反应等过程影响OA的发展。qRT-PCR和免疫组化验证了这些关键基因的表达，进一步证实了我们的发现。单核细胞和巨噬细胞在OA组织中大量浸润，持续的免疫激活状态可能促进OA的进展。乙炔雌二醇（ETHINYL ESTRADIOL）是OA可能的靶向治疗药物。同时，ceRNA网络分析识别出一些可能调控FRGs的lncRNAs。结论：我们确定了4个与生物氧化应激和免疫反应密切相关的FRGs（AQP8、BRD7、IFNA4和ARHGEF26-AS1），它们可能成为OA的早期诊断和治疗靶点。
